notes.title: Thorough explanation of Gadget functions in “M2STG LiveBroadcast 3 #1”!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Time to scramble—M2 Shot Triggers Live![/b][/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41309941/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png[/img]
M2, the developer of “Operation Night Strikers” and “Night Striker GEAR,” will broadcast the live program “M2STG LiveBroadcast 3 #1” on July 17, 2025 at 19:00.

"M2STG LiveBroadcast 3 #1" will introduce M2-developed titles, including Taito-related titles.
"Operation Night Strikers“ will be introduced with producer Yuichi Toyama, and ”Night Striker GEAR" will be shown in gameplay.
In addition...?

The streaming will take place on M2's YouTube channel. Please subscribe to the channel and look forward to the event.

notes.title: Steam Release on April 10th (Thu)!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535183/0c2df6d46c8628632c7988047ba090a2a9ce0ab7.png[/img]


Taito's Laser Disc (LD) anime games, Time Gal HD Remaster and Ninja Hayate HD Remaster, are finally coming to Steam on [b]April 9th (PDT)/ 10th (GMT), 2025[/b] so wishlist them now!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3050490?utm_source=steamNews&utm_term=250311
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3052550?utm_source=steamNews&utm_term=250311


A bundle pack that offers both games at a great price is also planned. 
We're counting down to the release with a daily death scene collection featuring everyone’s favourite scenes of failure from the games! The countdown starts from March 21st, so be sure to follow and check out the scenes in the coming days!
